name: Arctic Combat
summary: Arctic Combat is a Free-to-play online first-person shooter featuring a realistic gameplay experience powered by the Unreal Engine. Arctic Combat revolves around the story of a national conflict between two groups; the Allied Forces (AF) – led by the United States, and the Red Star Alliance (RSA) – led by Russia. What begins as a dispute over natural resources in the arctic leads to a violent clash between the AF and RSA, dividing the world into two opposing forces and marking the beginning of World War III.
